events.description: 44. ORDER denying Plaintiffs' requests for injunctive relief and granting 8 Motion to Dismiss for Failure to State a Claim with prejudice; granting 15 Motion to Dismiss for Failure to State a Claim with prejudice. For the reasons set forth herein, Plaintiffs' requests for injunctive relief are denied and the Defendants' motions to dismiss are granted with prejudice. The Clerk of the Court is respectfully requested to enter judgment and close this case. Ordered by Judge Ramon E. Reyes, Jr on 8/15/2024. (Reyes, Ramon) (Entered: 08/15/2024)

events.description: ORDER: the Court is in receipt of two documents emailed from Mr. John Tabacco to chambers staff. Mr. Tabacco is advised that this case has been dismissed with prejudice. (ECF Nos. re 45, 44 ). Should Mr. Tabacco or any of the other dismissed plaintiffs wish to pursue additional claims, they may file a new civil action by mailing a signed complaint to the pro se office. Any new action will be opened separately and not under this docket number. Plaintiffs are instructed not to send papers by email to chambers staff. Pro se litigants may not file a new case by email, by fax or electronically via cm/ecf. The Clerk of Court is respectfully directed mail Mr. Tabacco a copy of this order and note the mailing on the docket. Ordered by Judge Ramon E. Reyes, Jr on 11/6/2024. (MH)

events.description: 47. MANDATE of USCA as to 46 Notice of Appeal filed by Laura Schmit. IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that the appeal is dismissed effective October 8, 2024 unless by that date appellant either pays the fee in full, moves for in forma pauperis status in district court or, if district court has denied in forma pauperis status, moves in this Court for in forma pauperis status. If appellant has filed the motion in district court and the motion is pending, appellant must so advise this Court in writing by the same date. Issued as Mandate: 11/12/2024. USCA# 24-2270. (VJ) (Entered: 11/12/2024)
